title: Serving hierarchy
caption: The book's workload hierarchy from embedding lookups through ranking, vision, LLMs, diffusion and real-time audio. Our packet uses that breadth to motivate workload-specific mechanisms rather than treating LLM serving as the whole field.
alt: Hierarchy of machine-learning serving workloads with distinct bottlenecks and latency targets

title: Batching knee
caption: The book's throughput-versus-batch curve with fixed and marginal cost. Our batch-efficiency equation carries the same mechanism, while the original curve shows the knee visually.
alt: Throughput rising quickly with batch size before flattening near an asymptote

title: Continuous batching
caption: The book's iteration-level replacement diagram. Our padding-waste equation quantifies what the fixed-membership row leaves idle and continuous admission reclaims.
alt: Static batch slots padding shorter sequences while continuous batching admits new requests at iteration boundaries

title: KV-cache fragmentation
caption: The book's comparison of contiguous cache allocation with paged allocation. We use the KV bytes-per-token equation for admission accounting and cite this figure for the allocation mechanism.
alt: Contiguous KV cache blocks leaving unusable gaps compared with paged blocks filling memory more densely

title: Chunked prefill
caption: The book's interleaving of prompt chunks with decode iterations. Our disaggregation sketch shows the coarser architectural choice that follows when interleaving still compromises the two phases.
alt: Long prompt processing divided into chunks and interleaved with shorter decode steps

title: Disaggregated serving architecture
caption: The book's detailed prefill-pool and decode-pool architecture connected by RDMA KV transfer. Our packet uses a simplified lane diagram because the transfer term is the decision-relevant mechanism.
alt: Compute-bound prefill worker pool connected by KV cache transfer to bandwidth-bound decode worker pool

title: Tensor-parallel execution flow
caption: The book's tensor-parallel operator flow. We keep the communication cost in the scaling equation rather than reproducing the full operator decomposition.
alt: Matrix operation divided across devices with partial results combined through communication

title: Spot-aware routing
caption: The book's routing treatment for interruptible capacity. Our capacity-control section uses the same principle qualitatively: price is not capacity until interruption and cold-start terms are counted.
alt: Router steering traffic across stable and interruptible capacity pools
